arxiv-2207-01290.title: Resolving Vibrations in a Polyatomic Molecule with Femtometer Precision
arxiv-2207-01290.creator: Patrick Rupprecht, Lennart Aufleger, Simon Heinze, Alexander Magunia, Thomas Ding, Marc Rebholz, Stefano Amberg, Nikola Mollov, Felix Henrich, Maurits W. Haverkort, Christian Ott, Thomas Pfeifer
arxiv-2207-01290.description: Abstract We measure molecular vibrations with femtometer precision using time-resolved x-ray absorption spectroscopy. For a demonstration, a Raman process excites the A 1g mode in gas-phase SF 6 molecules with an amplitude of ≈ 50 \approx 50 fm, which is probed by a time-delayed soft x-ray pulse at the sulfur L 2 , 3 L_{2,3} -edge.

arxiv-2211-10338.title: Deep learning based landslide density estimation on SAR data for rapid response
arxiv-2211-10338.creator: Vanessa Boehm, Wei Ji Leong, Ragini Bal Mahesh, Ioannis Prapas, Edoardo Nemni, Freddie Kalaitzis, Siddha Ganju, Raul Ramos-Pollan
arxiv-2211-10338.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Vanessa Boehm, Wei Ji Leong, Ragini Bal Mahesh, Ioannis Prapas, Edoardo Nemni, Freddie Kalaitzis, Siddha Ganju, Raul Ramos-Pollan. This work aims to produce landslide density estimates using Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite imageries to prioritise emergency resources for rapid response.

arxiv-2412-18397.title: Scheme to Detect the Strong-to-weak Symmetry Breaking via Randomized Measurements
arxiv-2412-18397.creator: Ning Sun, Pengfei Zhang, Lei Feng
arxiv-2412-18397.description: Abstract Symmetry breaking plays a central role in classifying the phases of quantum many-body systems. Recent developments have highlighted a novel symmetry-breaking pattern, in which the strong symmetry of a density matrix spontaneously breaks to the week symmetry. This strong-to-weak symmetry breaking is typically detected using multi-replica correlation functions, such as the Rényi-2 correlator.

arxiv-2506-10719.title: The ALMA Survey of Gas Evolution of PROtoplanetary Disks (AGE-PRO): I. Program Overview and Summary of First Results Facilities: ALMA astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2018 ) , CASA ( CASA Team et al. 2022 ) , GoFish ( Teague 2019 ) , MATPLOTLIB ( Hunter 2007 ) , lifelines ( Davidson-Pilon 2024
arxiv-2506-10719.creator: Ke Zhang, Laura M. Pérez, Ilaria Pascucci, Paola Pinilla, Lucas A. Cieza, John Carpenter, Leon Trapman, Dingshan Deng, Carolina Agurto-Gangas, Anibal Sierra, Nicolás T. Kurtovic, Dary A. Ruíz-Rodríguez, Miguel Vioque, James Miley, Benoît Tabone, Camilo González-Ruilova, Rossella Anania, Giovanni P.
arxiv-2506-10719.description: Abstract We present the ALMA Survey of Gas Evolution of PROtoplanetary Disks (AGE-PRO), a Large Program of the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA). AGE-PRO aims to systematically trace the evolution of gas disk mass and size throughout the lifetime of protoplanetary disks.

arxiv-2509-03994.title: Generalized hypergeometric equations and 2 2 d TQFT for dormant opers in characteristic ≤ 7 \leq 7
arxiv-2509-03994.creator: Keita Mori, Yasuhiro Wakabayashi
arxiv-2509-03994.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Keita Mori, Yasuhiro Wakabayashi. This note studies PGL n \mathrm{PGL}_{n} -opers arising from generalized hypergeometric differential equations in prime characteristic p p . We prove that these opers are rigid within the class of dormant opers. By combining this rigidity result with previous work in the enumerative geometry of dormant opers, we obtain a complete and explicit description of the 2 2 d TQFTs that compute the number of dormant PGL n \mathrm{PGL}_{n} -opers for primes p ≤ 7 p\leq 7 .

arxiv-2510-23943.title: Adaptive Training of INRs via Pruning and Densification
arxiv-2510-23943.creator: Diana Aldana, João Paulo Lima, Daniel Csillag, Daniel Perazzo, [0.1cm] Haoan Feng, Luiz Velho, Tiago Novello, [0.2cm] IMPA
arxiv-2510-23943.description: Abstract Encoding input coordinates with sinusoidal functions into multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) has proven effective for implicit neural representations (INRs) of low-dimensional signals, enabling the modeling of high-frequency details. However, selecting appropriate input frequencies and architectures while managing parameter redundancy remains an open challenge, often addressed through heuristics and heavy hyperparameter optimization schemes.

pmc-10660520.title: Assessing the sustainability of the homestay industry for the East Coast of Malaysia using the Delphi approach
pmc-10660520.creator: Fatin Amira Zamzuki, Muhamad Safiih Lola, Elayaraja Aruchunan, Mohana Sundaram Muthuvalu, Ribed Vianneca W Jubilee, Nurul Hila Zainuddin, Abdul Aziz K Abdul Hamid, Nor Aieni Mokhtar, Mohd Tajuddin Abdullah
pmc-10660520.description: Homestay ecotourism in Malaysia has been extensively examined in terms of its concepts, approaches, activities, and community engagement. However, a comprehensive assessment of the sustainability factors pertaining to host families remains a critical area awaiting exploration. This is paramount for ensuring the long-term viability of homestays and fostering economic benefits within rural communities.

pmc-11367534.title: Color-coded circulation for visualizing swirling flow with a 3-dimensional helical stent in the superficial femoral artery
pmc-11367534.creator: Mitsunari Maruyama, Aso Hiroya, Hisatoshi Araki, Rika Yoshida, Shinji Ando, Megumi Nakamura, Takeshi Yoshizako, Yasushi Kaji
pmc-11367534.description: Color-coded circulation is a display method that generates dynamic color-coded images based on the time of arrival of contrast agents using parametric imaging to create video displays. By cyclically displaying information in color according to the arrival time of the contrast agent at each pixel, anatomical blood vessel paths and blood flow information can be simultaneously visualized.

pmc-11411233.title: Step-Based Dosing of Anticoagulants in COVID-19 Treatment
pmc-11411233.creator: Minh-Hoang Tran, Hoang Hai Nguyen, Quang Trung Nguyen, Thy Doan Minh Tran, Kim-Huong Truong-Nguyen, Hong Tham Pham
pmc-11411233.description: Background: Step-based dosing of anticoagulants has been widely implemented for the treatment of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), but no studies have comprehensively evaluated the effectiveness and safety of this approach. We aimed to investigate whether step-based dosing of anticoagulants was associated with clinical outcomes in patients with COVID-19 compared with standard prophylactic dosing.

pmc-11545190.title: Awareness of the Link Between Human Papilloma Virus Infection and Head and Neck Cancer Among the General Population and Practitioners: A Literature Review
pmc-11545190.creator: Alicia Tosoni, Linda Galvani, Vincenzo Di Nunno, Lidia Gatto, Stefania Bartolini, Marta Aprile, Elisa D’Angelo, Ernesto Pasquini, Anna Maria Baietti, Enrico Franceschi, Avraham Eisbruch
pmc-11545190.description: Simple SummaryHuman papilloma virus infection is responsible for 4.5% of cancers worldwide. Around 38,000 cases per year of HPV-related cancers arise in the head and neck region, of which 21,000 cases are oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas (OPSCCs), with an increasing frequency in high-income countries.

pmc-11603571.title: Biomechanical Evaluation of Ultra-High-Strength Suture Wire Versus Thinner Tape in Vertical Inside-Out Meniscal Suture
pmc-11603571.creator: JLR Faria, IF Araujo, APG Santos, ADO More, R Salim, CRM Roesler
pmc-11603571.description: ObjectivesMeniscal injuries are common and can significantly affect the function of the knee joint. Surgical repair is often necessary, with meniscal preservation being preferable to meniscectomy. This study aimed to compare the biomechanical properties of ultra-high-strength suture wire and thinner tape used in vertical inside-out meniscal suture.MethodsTwenty-eight porcine knees were selected for this controlled biomechanical evaluation in a laboratory setting.

pmc-11658562.title: A national Australian Congenital Heart Disease registry; methods and initial results
pmc-11658562.creator: Calum Nicholson, Geoff Strange, Julian Ayer, Michael Cheung, Leeanne Grigg, Robert Justo, Ryan Maxwell, Gavin Wheaton, Patrick Disney, Deane Yim, Simon Stewart, Rachael Cordina, David S Celermajer
pmc-11658562.description: BackgroundAlthough several National Data Registries for Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) exist, few are comprehensive and contemporary. A National Australian CHD Registry has been developed that aims to redress this by creating the first comprehensive data collection for CHD children and adults, initially across Australia.

pmc-12549171.title: Absence of SARS-CoV-2 in Second-Trimester Amniotic Fluid During the SARS-CoV-2 Virus Pandemic
pmc-12549171.creator: Poonam Samyal, Luis A Bracero, Andrew Quinn, Ying Chan
pmc-12549171.description: Objective:To determine the presence or absence of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) in second-trimester amniotic fluid during the SARS-CoV-2 virus pandemic in patients undergoing genetic amniocentesis.Study Design:Women undergoing amniocentesis between September 2020 and April 2022 were asked to participate in the study.

pmc-12559185.title: Amino acid dysregulation in cerebrospinal fluid of stroke patients serving as diagnostic biomarkers in post-neurosurgical bacterial meningitis
pmc-12559185.creator: Wei Chen, Yuanyuan Chen, Bohang Liu, Lu Ding, Chaojie Wang, Hongwei Cheng, Lei Ye
pmc-12559185.description: Post-neurosurgical bacterial meningitis (PNBM) is a severe complication following neurosurgical operations. However, clinical diagnosis of PNBM is difficult because of the complicated pathological conditions. This study aims to investigate alterations in amino acid metabolism in hemorrhagic stroke patients with PNBM through targeted metabolomics analysis.

pmc-12703113.title: Ultrasonographic Evaluation of Peripheral Nerves for Early Diagnosis of Guillain–Barré Syndrome: A Case‐Control Study
pmc-12703113.creator: Gholamreza Shamsaei, Mitra Sadrian, Amir Hossein Karimi, Shooka Mohammadi
pmc-12703113.description: Background and AimGuillain‐Barré syndrome (GBS) is an acute immune‐mediated neuropathy in which early diagnosis remains challenging because nerve conduction studies (NCS) may appear normal in the first few days after onset. Ultrasonography (US) has recently gained attention as a non‐invasive tool for evaluating peripheral nerve pathology.

uslaw-usc-t12-s16.title: 12 U.S.C. § 16 — Funding of Office
uslaw-usc-t12-s16.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s16.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 1 (The Comptroller Of The Currency). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Comptroller of the Currency may collect an assessment, fee, or other charge from any entity described in section 1813(q)(1) of this title, as the Comptroller determines is necessary or appropriate to carry out the responsibilities of the Office of the Comptroller.

uslaw-usc-t16-s8463.title: 16 U.S.C. § 8463 — Pay-for-performance projects
uslaw-usc-t16-s8463.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s8463.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 103 (Expanding Public Lands Outdoor Recreation Experiences); Subchapter I (Outdoor Recreation And Infrastructure); Part E (Public–Private Parks Partnerships). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Independent evaluator The term “independent evaluator” means an individual or entity, including an institution of higher education, that is selected by the pay-for-performance beneficiary and pay-for-performance.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2211.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2211 — Payment of claims or judgments for damage resulting from nuclear incident involving nuclear reactor of United States warship; exception; terms and conditions
uslaw-usc-t42-s2211.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2211.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 23 (Development And Control Of Atomic Energy); Subchapter XIII (General Authority Of Commission). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the policy of the United States that it will pay claims or judgments for bodily injury, death, or damage to or loss of real or personal property proven to have resulted.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2286h.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2286h — Contract authority subject to appropriations
uslaw-usc-t42-s2286h.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2286h.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 23 (Development And Control Of Atomic Energy); Subchapter XVII–A (Defense Nuclear Facilities Safety Board). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The authority of the Board to enter into contracts under this subchapter is effective only to the extent that appropriations (including transfers of appropriations) are provided in advance for such purpose.

uslaw-usc-t49-s31308.title: 49 U.S.C. § 31308 — Commercial driver’s license
uslaw-usc-t49-s31308.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t49-s31308.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part B (Commercial); Chapter 313 (Commercial Motor Vehicle Operators). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. After consultation with the States, the Secretary of Transportation shall prescribe regulations on minimum uniform standards for the issuance of commercial drivers’ licenses and learner’s permits by the States and for information to be contained on each of the licenses and permits.
